newsitem.title: INDIA: India's TELCO 96/97 sales seen up 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's TELCO 96/97 sales seen up 19 pct.

text.p: Sales of India's largest truckmaker, Tata Engineering and Locomotive Co Ltd (TELCO), climbed 19 percent during 1996/97 (April-March), a source close to the company told Reuters.

He said TELCO's vehicle sales had jumped to 215,276 during the financial year ended March 31, 1997, from 181,200 a year earlier. Exports -- included in total sales -- fell slightly to 15,021 units from 16,581 in 1995/96.
Automobile analysts have been forecasting sales of around 205,000 to 210,000 vehicles.
TELCO's production during 1996/97 rose 20 percent to 218,393 units, from 181,401 in the previous year, the source told Reuters.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
TELCO is expected to release its fiscal 96/97 results in May. No date has yet been set.
Offictial automobile figures for India are due to be released later this week.
